posts.title: What the GRUB? Installing a new OS when EFI won’t load
posts.description: The other day, I tried to open the Shudder app on our Fire TV, only to be frustrated when it didn’t load. After searching the internet for any suggestions (as one does), I learned that our Fire TV’s operating system was old. Like, real old.
